items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And then I'd go down to Baron's, down to Baron Wilkins. He had a brother named Leroy.

ctx.x: She'd sing and then I'd ask her -- I'm trying to think. It wasn't 'God Blessed the Child,' because that was later. Some song Billy used to sing for me every night I'd go in there, I'd give her money to sing this particular song. But anyhow, I'd have her sing for me every night, you know. Every night when I would get off from work, I'd go right into the Hotcha to hear Billie. And then I'd go down to Baron's, down to Baron Wilkins. He had a brother named Leroy.
